DARKTIDE MOD MANAGER
Standalone Windows x64 release

Extract this archive and run DarktideModManager.exe. This self-contained build includes
the .NET runtime and the Nexus Mods and Darktide button icons; no separate runtime or
asset files are needed.

The manager defaults to:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Warhammer 40,000 DARKTIDE

The app's local settings are stored at:
%LOCALAPPDATA%\DarktideModManager\settings.json

Do not include your settings file when sharing this app. It may contain your selected
game folder and a Windows-account-encrypted Nexus API key.

This is a non-commercial, fan-made utility and is not affiliated with or endorsed by
Fatshark, Games Workshop, Valve, or Nexus Mods.

Button image credits:
